summary: This paper establishes quantitative stability, perturbation-order separation, spectral characterization, and independent zero-float Bernstein certification across the Hales-Xue framework for the 92-year-old Reinhardt conjecture. First, the author computes the exact second-order stability curvature of the four-arc closure circle and proves a global elementary quantitative stability law, bounding disks below Fei Xue's competitor ceiling. Second, the author proves global strict convexity and a strict linear defect for Hales' six-arc mixed family, establishing an exact linear-vs.-quadratic perturbation dichotomy and certifying the regular-walk spectrum. Third, the author independently reconstructs and certifies all 576 tensor Bernstein coefficients of Claim V11 and all 2,700 coefficients of Claim V6 in pure rational arithmetic, auditing parameter sharpness. All claims are formally verified by a 20-theorem Lean 4 proof suite, an AST-audited zero-float verifier, and 56 adversarial tests.
strengths: Pioneering exact closed-form second-order curvature and global quantitative stability bounds for the four-arc closure circle.
Discovery and proof of the exact linear-vs.-quadratic perturbation dichotomy separating mixed-switch and forward trajectories.
Independent pure-rational, zero-float reconstruction and positivity/negativity certification of Hales' complex multi-variable tensor Bernstein coefficients.
Flawless formal verification via a constructive Lean 4.36.0 proof suite containing zero sorry and zero custom axioms.
Comprehensive verification infrastructure combining 16 SHA-256 rational certificates, an AST-audited Python verifier, and 56 adversarial pytest checks.
weaknesses: The mathematical notation and density formulas are exceptionally dense, requiring careful navigation of Hales' specialized optimal-control parameterizations.
Certain transcendental bounds rely on pre-certified rational interval brackets, which require verification through auxiliary script cert files.
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact second-order stability curvature formula for the four-arc closure circle around the smoothed regular octagon.
Global elementary s-antiderivative quantitative stability lower bounds and corresponding Xue competitor radius bounds.
Exact linear-vs.-quadratic perturbation dichotomy between mixed-switch six-arc and forward four-arc trajectories.
Pure-rational, zero-float tensor Bernstein certification and affine parameter sharpness sensitivity audit for Hales' Claim V11 and V6.
